title: Discriminant -23 split target coordinate-gcd operator estimate

result.name: CN3SplitTargetGcd
result.scope: Let Q=x^2+xy+6y^2, O=Z[(1+sqrt(-23))/2] plus its j-copy, j^2=-1. For a split prime p!=23, N=p^t m with t>=1 and gcd(m,23p)=1, b counts signed ordered norm-N elements outside pO whose first or second binary block is divisible by p; zero blocks are included.
result.bound: With w=3/11, abs(b - 16w*p^(t-1)*sigma(m)/(p+1)) <= 16t*p^(t/2)*tau(m)*sqrt(m). At t=1 the error improves to 8*tau(m)*sqrt(m).
result.normalization: Principal maximal mass w=3/11; principal Iwahori axis-orbit mass 2w/(p+1); b=8(V_t T_m f)(x_A), V_t=B^(t-1)F degree p^(t-1). Rank-one bad density 4/(p+1)^2 against the p-primitive baseline.
limits: Not the complete separately primitive -23 sumset or an all-prime lower sieve.
The pO branch for target valuations at least two is not included in b.
No historical priority or external-review assertion.

proof_dependencies.scope: Commuting self-adjoint all-integral-ideal T_m of degree sigma(m), complementary norm tau(m)sqrt(m) after removing all global reduced-norm characters; unramified local roots of magnitude sqrt(p).
proof_dependencies.hypotheses_checked: At fine Iwahori-p level this is applied only to m prime23p. For the compression P0FP0=T_p/(p+1) it is applied at coarser maximal-p level. The Iwahori nonspherical joint-projection kernel and two-frame bound are proved separately in S3-S5. All compact unit norm images are full local units, so over Q the only global norm character is constant.
